name: Biotope Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Biotope: natural soundscapes and evolving drones by style. Ambient, Nature, Weather, Water, Meditation, Sleep, Cinematic, Sci-Fi, Dark Ambient, Lo-fi, Field Recording, Interiors and Rhythmic footsteps. Each tune sets all eight layers (rain, drops, bubbles, wind, footsteps, fire, sea, creaks), space and stereo width, and is level-matched.
